svg.title: Volunteer coordinator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as volunteer coordinator, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: A volunteer rota with attendance marks sits above an open offering hand. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
